critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 5965 lines — the qc9434_* block (>1500 lines including cashflow, payment history, reminders) really should be extracted to backend/qc9434.py. This is repeatedly flagged; growing risk of merge conflicts.

_qc_etats_financiers cashflow logic assumes bal[gl]['opening'] and bal[gl]['cumulative'] are the year's opening/closing balances — correct for the current _qc_report_balances impl, but if that helper is ever changed to include cross-year cumulative, cashflow will silently drift. Add a unit-level assertion `assert abs(cash_open + net_var - cash_close) < 1.0` inside _qc_etats_financiers with a logger.warning to catch such regressions in prod.

qc_invoice_send_reminders imports `resend` inside the function AFTER the _email_configured() guard — good, no crash when lib missing. But it does not fall back to skipping instead of 400 when at least ONE invoice has an email; consider: if Resend is configured but zero overdue invoices, currently the endpoint would return {success:True, sent:[], skipped:[], message:'0 rappel(s) envoyé(s)'} — user would not know why nothing was sent. Add a distinct message 'Aucune facture en retard à relancer.' for this case.

_qc_payment_history sums debit for 'receipt' and credit for 'payment' filtered on QC_DEF['cash'] — correct for the standard entries produced by receive/pay endpoints, but would miss payments if a user posts a manual receipt entry that uses account 100105 (autre banque) instead of QC_DEF['cash']=100110. Consider expanding to any cash-family account.

The frontend qc-ar-remind-btn is conditionally rendered on `overdueCount > 0`. Since all seeded invoices land as either 'open' with future due_date or 'paid', the button rarely appears in demos. Consider always showing it (disabled when count=0) so users discover the feature.

InvoicesView still lacks a client_email input in qc-invoice-dialog (flagged in iter 37 — still not fixed). Without it, the email-send + remind features are unreachable for invoices created after model import, unless the client_email happens to already exist.
